Shining Fates Shiny Vault

Released February 19, 2021 · 122 cards

Expanded

Shining Fates Shiny Vault is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on February 19, 2021. It has 122 cards. It includes 122 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

31 illustrators worked on Shining Fates Shiny Vault. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (13), Kouki Saitou (7), Shin Nagasawa (7), Akira Komayama (6), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Masakazu Fukuda (6), nagimiso (6), Shigenori Negishi (6).
